steps.en: Install the pack into your agent with the skills CLI
steps.zh: 用 skills CLI 把整套包装进 agent

component.zh: skills/ 目录 + SKILL.md 文件

steps.en: Ask the agent to build or redesign a frontend page
steps.zh: 让 agent 构建或重设计一个前端页面

steps.en: Loads the taste skill: reads the brief, infers the design language, maps it to colors, type and spacing
steps.zh: 加载 taste skill：读 brief、推断设计语言并映射到设计系统

steps.en: Applies the GSAP motion skeletons and runs anti-repetition and pre-flight checks
steps.zh: 套用 GSAP 动效骨架，跑反重复与 pre-flight 检查

steps.en: Retune the three dials at the top of the skill to steer future output
steps.zh: 调整 skill 文件顶部的三个旋钮，校准后续输出

value.en: Intentional layout, typography and motion in agent-generated UI without hand-writing a design brief every prompt
value.zh: agent 产出的 UI 有刻意的布局、排版与动效，不必每条 prompt 手写设计 brief

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09: Install section `npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill`; Skills table (taste-skill = v2 experimental, install name design-taste-frontend; v2 description: brief inference, design-system map, canonical GSAP code skeletons, anti-repetition, strict pre-flight check); Settings section: DESIGN_VARIANCE / MOTION_INTENSITY / VISUAL_DENSITY, numbers at the top of the file are 1-10 dials
